# Filter ddRADseq SNP data
```{bash, eval = FALSE}
#! /usr/bin/env bash
#SBATCH --mail-type=FAIL,END
#SBATCH --mail-user=tcm0036@auburn.edu
#SBATCH --partition=jro0014_amd
#SBATCH --mem=32G
#SBATCH --error=snpfilt_%j.err
#SBATCH --output=snpfilt_%j.out
#SBATCH --time=24:00:00
#SBATCH --job-name=SNPFilter

## Load conda env with bcftools
source ~/mambaforge/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate genomics_env

VCF=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/stacks/populations/populations.snps.vcf
CLEAN=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/bcftools/dropped_samples.vcf.gz
VCF50=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/bcftools/full_miss50_snps.vcf.gz
VCF90=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/bcftools/full_miss90_snps.vcf.gz
OUT_DIR=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/bcftools
INDMISS=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/bcftools/missingness_per_ind.txt


### Calculate missingness per specimen
paste \
<(bcftools query -f '[%SAMPLE\t]\n' $VCF | head -1 | tr '\t' '\n') \
<(bcftools query -f '[%GT\t]\n' $VCF | awk -v OFS="\t" '{for (i=1;i<=NF;i++) if ($i == "./.") sum[i]+=1 } END {for (i in sum) print i, sum[i] / NR }' | sort -k1,1n | cut -f 2) > $INDMISS

### Drop specimens with > 
bcftools view -S ^<(paste <(bcftools query -f '[%SAMPLE\t]\n' $VCF | head -1 | tr '\t' '\n') <(bcftools query -f '[%GT\t]\n' $VCF | awk -v OFS="\t" '{for (i=1;i<=NF;i++) if ($i == "./.") sum[i]+=1 } END {for (i in sum) print i, sum[i] / NR }' | sort -k1,1n | cut -f 2) | awk '{ if ($2 > 0.85) print $1 }') $VCF | bgzip > $CLEAN

### Filter SNPs for depth, missingness (50%), quality, and minor alleles
bcftools filter -i 'FORMAT/DP > 5' $CLEAN | \
#     bcftools filter -e 'FORMAT/DP>1.5*AVG(FORMAT/DP)' | \
        bcftools filter -e 'F_MISSING > 0.5' | \
        bcftools view --min-ac 3 -m2 -M2 -v snps |\
        bcftools sort -O z -o $VCF50
bcftools index $VCF50

### Filter SNPs for depth, missingness (90%), quality, and minor alleles
bcftools filter -i 'FORMAT/DP > 5' $CLEAN | \
#       bcftools filter -e 'FORMAT/DP>1.5*AVG(FORMAT/DP)' | \
        bcftools filter -e 'F_MISSING > 0.1' | \
        bcftools view --min-ac 3 -m2 -M2 -v snps | \ 
        bcftools sort -O z -o $VCF90
bcftools index $VCF90

### Physical linkage
plink --vcf $VCF50 --bp-space 1000 --allow-extra-chr --set-missing-var-ids @:# --make-bed --recode vcf --out $OUT_DIR/full_miss50_LD

plink --vcf $VCF90 --bp-space 1000 --allow-extra-chr --set-missing-var-ids @:# --make-bed --recode vcf --out $OUT_DIR/full_miss90_LD
```

# Visualize filtered dataset sampling
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(vcfR)
library(stringr)

### read in sampling information
popmap <- read_table("~/Dropbox/Distichus_Project/brevirostris-ms/brevirostris-project-master-popmap-detailed.tsv")
unique(popmap$taxon)

### 50% missingness VCF from PLINK (14,774 biallelic SNPs)
vcf50 <- read.vcfR("~/Dropbox/Distichus_Project/brevirostris-ms/data/pop-gen/full_miss50_LD.vcf")
vcf50

### 90% missingness VCF from PLINK (3,339 biallelic SNPs)
vcf90 <- read.vcfR("~/Dropbox/Distichus_Project/brevirostris-ms/data/pop-gen/full_miss90_LD.vcf")
vcf90

### Are specimens the same across VCFs?
colnames(vcf90@gt)[2:299] == colnames(vcf50@gt)[2:299]

### Stupid PLINK artifact means I have to modify the names to get matches in spreadsheet
vcf_specimens <- str_split(colnames(vcf90@gt)[2:299], "_", simplify = TRUE)
vcf_specimens <- apply(vcf_specimens, 1, function(row){
    if(row[1] == row[2]) {
        return(row[1])
    } else {
        return(paste(row[1], row[2], sep = "_"))
    }
})

### Exclude dropped specimens and re-order to match order of VCFs
popmap <- popmap %>%
        filter(specimen_path %in% vcf_specimens) %>%
        arrange(factor(specimen_path, levels = vcf_specimens))
# write.table(popmap, file = "sampling-master-detailed.tsv")
### Need to drop duplicate of 8304
```

## Make figure
```{r, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 12}
hi <- ggplot() + geom_sf(data = world_cropped) +
    coord_sf(ylim = c(17.4, 20.2), xlim = c(-74.55, -68.25)) +
        geom_point(data = popmap, aes(x = longitude, y = latitude, fill = population_post, shape = clade), size = 4, color = "black", stroke = 0.5, alpha = 0.8, show.legend = TRUE) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = cols, labels = col_labs, name = "Taxon") +
        scale_shape_manual(values = shps, labels = shp_labs, name = "Major Clades") +
        theme_classic() + xlab("Longitude") + ylab("Latitude") +
        guides(fill = guide_legend(label.theme = element_text(face = "italic"), override.aes = list(shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.5)),
                shape = guide_legend(label.theme = element_text(face = "italic"), override.aes = list(fill = "gray50", color = "black", stroke = 0.5)))

leg <- get_legend(hi)
hi <- hi + theme(legend.position = "none")

ba <- ggplot() + geom_sf(data = world_cropped) +
        coord_sf(xlim = c(-79, -72.6), ylim = c(22, 26.9)) +
        geom_point(data = popmap, aes(x = longitude, y = latitude, fill = population_post, shape = clade), size = 4, color = "black", alpha = 0.8, show.legend = TRUE) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = cols, labels = col_labs) +
        scale_shape_manual(values = shps, labels = shp_labs, name = "Major Clades") +
        theme_classic() + xlab("Longitude") + ylab("Latitude") +
        theme(legend.position = "none")

map_fig <- grid.arrange(ba, hi, ncol = 2, widths = c(5, 15))
plot(map_fig)
```

# Principal components analysis

These PCAs are largely to identify mis-identified samples and to divide samples into species complex-specific analyses. I will redo them after dropping problematic samples.

```{r}
library(adegenet)

### convert VCF to adegenet format
gen50 <- vcfR2genlight(vcf50)
gen90 <- vcfR2genlight(vcf90)

### drop duplicate sample
gen50 <- gen50[!gen50@ind.names %in% "8304.pietro.aligned.sorted_8304.pietro.aligned.sorted", ]
gen90 <- gen90[!gen90@ind.names %in% "8304.pietro.aligned.sorted_8304.pietro.aligned.sorted", ]
```

## 50% complete dataset
```{r}
# pca50 <- glPca(gen50, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE, nf = 4)
# save(pca50, file = "~/Dropbox/Distichus_Project/brevirostris-ms/data/pop-gen/glPca_vcf50.RData")
load("~/Dropbox/Distichus_Project/brevirostris-ms/data/pop-gen/glPca_vcf50.RData")

pve50 <- 100*pca50$eig/sum(pca50$eig)
pve50
```

```{r}
df <- as_tibble(cbind(popmap, as.data.frame(pca50$scores)), col_names = c(colnames(popmap), paste0("PC", 1:(ncol(pca50$scores)-1))))
# col_labs <- names(cols)

ggplot(data = df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = population_post, label = specimen, alpha = 0.85)) +
    geom_text() +
    geom_point(cex = 3) + scale_color_manual(values = cols, labels = col_labs,
        guide = guide_legend(label.theme = element_text(angle = 0, face = "italic"))) +
    guides(alpha = "none") +
    labs(color = "Taxon", x = paste0("Axis 1 (", round(pve50[1], digits = 1), "% of variation)"), y = paste0("Axis 2 (", round(pve50[2], digits = 1), "% of variation)")) +
    theme(panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, size = 3),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 24, colour = "black", family = "Helvetica", face = "bold"))
```

There's one dom4, a few mis-ID'd as favillarum, and some brevirostris. I'll re-assign the brevirostris samples to the distichus subset for hierarchical analyses.

# Re-assign samples based on clustering
```{r, eval=F}
brevs <- popmap[popmap$complex == "brevirostris",]
distichus <- popmap[popmap$complex == "distichus",]

misIDs <- c(590, 1198, 5683, 7368)

distichus <- popmap %>% filter(specimen %in% misIDs) %>% rbind(distichus) %>% filter(specimen_path != "8304.pietro.aligned.sorted")
brevs <- brevs %>% filter(!(specimen %in% misIDs ))
# write.table(brevs, "brevirostris-popmap.tsv", row.names = F, quote = F, sep = "\t")
# write.table(distichus, "distichus-popmap.tsv", row.names = F, quote = F, sep = "\t")
```

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
awk -F"\t" '$4 == "brevirostris" {print}' brevirostris-project-master-popmap-detailed.tsv > brevirostris-popmap.tsv

awk -F"\t" '$4 == "distichus" {print}' brevirostris-project-master-popmap-detailed.tsv > distichus-popmap.tsv      

### Add "brevirostris" that cluster with distichus to distichus file
grep -w "590" brevirostris-popmap.tsv | tee -a distichus-popmap.tsv
grep -w "1198" brevirostris-popmap.tsv | tee -a distichus-popmap.tsv
grep -w "5683" brevirostris-popmap.tsv | tee -a distichus-popmap.tsv
grep -w "7368" brevirostris-popmap.tsv | tee -a distichus-popmap.tsv 

### drop those same samples
grep -w -v "590" brevirostris-popmap.tsv > tmp && mv tmp brevirostris-popmap.tsv
grep -w -v "1198" brevirostris-popmap.tsv > tmp && mv tmp brevirostris-popmap.tsv 
grep -w -v "5683" brevirostris-popmap.tsv > tmp && mv tmp brevirostris-popmap.tsv 
grep -w -v "7368" brevirostris-popmap.tsv > tmp && mv tmp brevirostris-popmap.tsv  

### Drop replicate of sample with less data
grep -v "8304.pietro" distichus-popmap.tsv > tmp && mv tmp distichus-popmap.tsv
```

That leaves us with a total of 50 members of the *brevirostris* species complex and a total of 257 *distichus*.

# *Anolis brevirostris* complex only

## 90 % complete dataset -- PCA
```{r}
popmap <- read_table("~/Dropbox/Distichus_Project/brevirostris-ms/brevirostris-popmap.tsv")

br90 <- read.vcfR("~/Dropbox/Distichus_Project/brevirostris-ms/data/pop-gen/brevirostris/brevirostris_miss90_LD.vcf")
colnames(br90@gt)[2:46] <- popmap$specimen
br90_gen <- vcfR2genlight(br90)

br90_pca <- glPca(br90_gen, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE, nf = 3)
```

```{r}
pve90 <- 100*br90_pca$eig/sum(br90_pca$eig)
pve90
```

```{r}
df <- as_tibble(cbind(popmap, as.data.frame(br90_pca$scores)), col_names = c(colnames(popmap), paste0("PC", 1:(ncol(pca50$scores)-1))))
br_labs <- col_labs[names(col_labs) %in% popmap$taxon]
br_cols <- cols[names(cols) %in% names(br_labs)]

ggplot(data = df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = taxon, label = specimen, alpha = 0.85)) +
    geom_text() +
    geom_point(cex = 3) + scale_color_manual(values = br_cols, labels = br_labs,
        guide = guide_legend(label.theme = element_text(angle = 0, face = "italic"))) +
    guides(alpha = "none") +
    labs(color = "Taxon", x = paste0("Axis 1 (", round(pve90[1], digits = 1), "% of variation)"),
        y = paste0("Axis 2 (", round(pve90[2], digits = 1), "% of variation)")) +
    theme(panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, size = 3),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 24, colour = "black", family = "Helvetica", face = "bold"))
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = df, aes(x = PC2, y = PC3, color = taxon, label = specimen, alpha = 0.85)) +
    geom_text() +
    geom_point(cex = 3) + scale_color_manual(values = br_cols, labels = br_labs,
        guide = guide_legend(label.theme = element_text(angle = 0, face = "italic"))) +
    guides(alpha = "none") +
    labs(color = "Taxon", x = paste0("Axis 2 (", round(pve90[2], digits = 1), "% of variation)"),
        y = paste0("Axis 3 (", round(pve90[3], digits = 1), "% of variation)")) +
    theme(panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, size = 3),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 24, colour = "black", family = "Helvetica", face = "bold"))
```

```{r}
pc1_2 <- ggplot(data = df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, fill = taxon, label = specimen, shape = complex, alpha = 0.95, size = 4)) +
    geom_point() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = br_cols, labels = br_labs,
        guide = guide_legend(label.theme = element_text(angle = 0, face = "italic"))) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(21), labels = c("A. brevirostris", "A. distichus"), name = "Species Complex") +
    guides(alpha = "none") +
    labs(color = "Taxon", x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pve90[1], digits = 1), "% of variation)"), y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pve90[2], digits = 1), "% of variation)")) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, size = 3)
    )
pc2_3 <- ggplot(data = df, aes(x = PC2, y = PC3, fill = taxon, shape = complex, label = specimen, alpha = 0.95, size = 4)) +
    geom_point() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = br_cols, labels = br_labs,
        guide = guide_legend(label.theme = element_text(angle = 0, face = "italic"))) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(21), labels = c("A. brevirostris", "A. distichus"), name = "Species Complex") +
    guides(alpha = "none") +
    labs(color = "Taxon", x = paste0("PC2 (", round(pve90[2], digits = 1), "% of variation)"), y = paste0("PC3 (", round(pve90[3], digits = 1), "% of variation)")) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, size = 3)
    )

ab_pc <- grid.arrange(pc1_2, pc2_3, nrow = 1, ncol = 2)
```

```{r}
br_fig <- grid.arrange(ab_fig, ab_pc, nrow = 2, ncol = 1, heights = c(8,6))
ggsave(filename = "/Users/tannermyers/Dropbox/Apps/Overleaf/distichus_tree/figures/brev-complex-sampling-pca.png", plot = br_fig, width = 16, height = 12, dpi = 300)
```
